001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.fleets;
002
003import java.util.Random;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.EveryFrameScript;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.BattleAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignEventListener.FleetDespawnReason;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.listeners.FleetEventListener;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.PersonAPI;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.People;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
016
017public abstract class PersonalFleetScript implements EveryFrameScript, FleetEventListener {
018        
019        protected String personId;
020        
021        protected float minRespawnDelayDays = 1f;
022        protected float maxRespawnDelayDays = 2f;
023        
024        protected float minFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays = 1f;
025        protected float maxFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays = 2f;
026        protected float currDelay;
027        protected CampaignFleetAPI fleet;
028        protected Random random = new Random();
029        protected boolean done = false;
030        protected String defeatTrigger = null;
031        
032        protected float origFP = 0f;
033        
034        public PersonalFleetScript(String personId) {
035                this.personId = personId;
036                Global.getSector().addScript(this);
037        }
038        
039        public static<T> T getScript(Class<T> scriptClass) {
040                for (EveryFrameScript curr : Global.getSector().getScripts()) {
041                        if (scriptClass.isInstance(curr)) {
042                                return (T)curr;
043                        }
044                }
045                return null;
046        }
047        public static CampaignFleetAPI getFleet(Class<?> scriptClass) {
048                for (EveryFrameScript curr : Global.getSector().getScripts()) {
049                        if (scriptClass.isInstance(curr)) {
050                                return ((PersonalFleetScript)curr).getFleet();
051                        }
052                }
053                return null;
054        }
055        
056        public PersonAPI getPerson() {
057                return People.getPerson(personId);
058        }
059        
060        public boolean isDone() {
061                return done;
062        }
063
064        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
065                return false;
066        }
067
068        public String getDefeatTrigger() {
069                return defeatTrigger;
070        }
071
072        public void setDefeatTrigger(String defeatTrigger) {
073                this.defeatTrigger = defeatTrigger;
074        }
075
076        protected abstract MarketAPI getSourceMarket();
077        
078        public void advance(float amount) {
079                if (amount <= 0 || isDone()) return;
080                
081                if (fleet != null && !fleet.isAlive()) {
082                        fleet = null;
083                }
084                
085                if (fleet == null) {
086                        float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
087                        currDelay -= days;
088                        if (currDelay <= 0f) {
089                                currDelay = 0f;
090                                
091                                if (shouldScriptBeRemoved() || getPerson() == null) {
092                                        done = true;
093                                        return;
094                                }
095                                
096                                if (canSpawnFleetNow()) {
097                                        spawnFleetAndDoRelatedHousekeeping();
098                                }
099                                if (fleet == null) {
100                                        currDelay = minFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays + 
101                                                           (maxFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays - minFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays) * random.nextFloat();
102                                }
103                        }
104                }
105        }
106        
107        public void spawnFleetAndDoRelatedHousekeeping() {
108                fleet = spawnFleet();
109                if (fleet != null) {
110                        origFP = fleet.getFleetPoints();
111                        MarketAPI source = getSourceMarket();
112                        if (source != null) {
113                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET, source.getId());
114                        }
115                        fleet.addEventListener(this);
116                        if (defeatTrigger != null) {
117                                Misc.addDefeatTrigger(fleet, defeatTrigger);
118                        }
119                }
120        }
121
122        
123        public abstract CampaignFleetAPI spawnFleet();
124        public abstract boolean canSpawnFleetNow();
125        public abstract boolean shouldScriptBeRemoved(); 
126
127        public void reportFleetDespawnedToListener(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, FleetDespawnReason reason, Object param) {
128                if (fleet == this.fleet) {
129                        this.fleet = null;
130                        currDelay = minRespawnDelayDays + 
131                                           (maxRespawnDelayDays - minRespawnDelayDays) * random.nextFloat();
132                }
133        }
134
135        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
136                float currFP = fleet.getFleetPoints();
137                if (currFP < origFP * 0.33f && !Misc.isFleetReturningToDespawn(fleet)) {
138                        Misc.giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(fleet);
139                }
140        }
141
142        public String getPersonId() {
143                return personId;
144        }
145
146        public void setPersonId(String personId) {
147                this.personId = personId;
148        }
149
150        public float getMinRespawnDelayDays() {
151                return minRespawnDelayDays;
152        }
153
154        public void setMinRespawnDelayDays(float minRespawnDelayDays) {
155                this.minRespawnDelayDays = minRespawnDelayDays;
156        }
157
158        public float getMaxRespawnDelayDays() {
159                return maxRespawnDelayDays;
160        }
161
162        public void setMaxRespawnDelayDays(float maxRespawnDelayDays) {
163                this.maxRespawnDelayDays = maxRespawnDelayDays;
164        }
165
166        public float getMinFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays() {
167                return minFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays;
168        }
169
170        public void setMinFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays(float minFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays) {
171                this.minFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays = minFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays;
172        }
173
174        public float getMaxFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays() {
175                return maxFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays;
176        }
177
178        public void setMaxFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays(float maxFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays) {
179                this.maxFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays = maxFailedSpawnRespawnDelayDays;
180        }
181
182        public float getCurrDelay() {
183                return currDelay;
184        }
185
186        public void setCurrDelay(float currDelay) {
187                this.currDelay = currDelay;
188        }
189
190        public CampaignFleetAPI getFleet() {
191                return fleet;
192        }
193
194        public void setFleet(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
195                this.fleet = fleet;
196        }
197
198        public Random getRandom() {
199                return random;
200        }
201
202        public void setRandom(Random random) {
203                this.random = random;
204        }
205
206        public float getOrigFP() {
207                return origFP;
208        }
209        
210        
211}
